unit_note: 1 paper unit = $100 notional at entry floor, fixed for every ticket; never sized by conviction
open_rules: Open when scoring puts a name at highest conviction (call), plus the run's single strongest watch if clearly best and above its kill line. One open ticket per name. Window 48h.
close_rules: Close at kill line, window end, or thesis break. Early exit: holders fall on two consecutive marks while mark < entry, OR CS/GlintLore sellers > buyers on 3 consecutive marks while mark < entry. Mark to OpenSea/GlintLore floor; prefer real sale prices where available.
